audit.why: Early/mid Qiyana-favored (59.4% WR, chart Qiyana L1-first item, Azir 2+ items) matches prose: Azir weak early, outscales late.
Spikes at L3, L6, first item, and the late flip to Azir are recorded and consistent with the level chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text calls Azir's dash 'Conquering Sands (E)' — Conquering Sands is his Q; the shield-dash is Shifting Sands (E, 22s rank 1). Also breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers.
audit.why: Kit file: Q=Conquering Sands 14/12/10/8/6, E=Shifting Sands 22/20.5/19/17.5/16 with a shield. The E shield also absorbs burst (missingInteractions) — noted in edits.
audit.corrected: Renamed to Shifting Sands (E); real cooldowns added to breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged wants.foe[1] 'Emperor's Divide' — false positive, that is the real R name per the kit.

edits.before: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. Check it before every step-up. - W Terrashape (element swap) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Azir Shifting Sands (E): matchup-defining — a 22s shield-dash at rank 1, 16s max. Engage the window after he burns it; the shield also eats your burst, so force it first. - Conquering Sands (Q) runs 14s early — soldiers committed to the wave cannot kite you. - The ult answers fights, not waves.

edits.before: Grass-Q from stealth, E-ice the answer, auto, walk back into the hedge — terrain trades he experiences as ambush weather.
edits.after: When he steps up to place a soldier, E onto him with ice loaded — the Q root pins him for the full auto-Q string before he can dash.

edits.before: E-ing in with no element loaded and his CC banked — Qiyana without terrain prep is a dagger doing improv.
edits.after: Terrashape is 7 seconds of no element if you swap idly — enter every trade holding the element the next window actually needs.

edits.before: With all three basics you can W onto a wall for the root-element, walk up behind soldiers and E-Q the moment his Conquering Sands (E) dash is down. Azir has no self-peel until 6, so every time his soldiers are on cooldown the wave is yours to freeze and dive.
edits.after: With all three basics you can W onto a wall for the root-element, walk up behind soldiers and E-Q the moment his Shifting Sands (E) dash is down — a 22-second cooldown at rank 1. Azir has no self-peel until 6, so when his soldiers are on cooldown the wave is yours to dive.

notes: suspectNames entry for 'Emperor's Divide' is a false positive (real R name). Azir E shield-absorbs-burst missing interaction now covered in breakdown.cooldowns. Level chart layers already agree; no side changes needed.
